svg.aria-label: The whole periodic table with the numbers 1 to 18 across the top labeled groups, and 1 to 7 down the side labeled periods; every cell of the first column, group 1, and of the last column, group 18, is ringed
svg.text: 57–71 and 89–103 are 30 more metals, usually printed in two extra rows; this drawing leaves them out.
